quiz.prompt: Which statement best describes a class and its objects?
options: A class defines a type; each object is an instance with its own non-static data.
Every object contains every other object of the same class.
A class is simply a variable holding one value.
quiz.explanation: The class defines the structure and operations. p1 and p2 are separate objects; each stores its own x and y.

quiz.prompt: Which statement is valid outside Point when x is private and setX is public?
quiz.explanation: Use the public interface. private blocks direct access from unrelated code; it does not prevent member functions from using x.

quiz.prompt: What does Point p; produce in the basic example?
options: Uninitialized coordinates, because p has no arguments.
A Point with coordinates (0,0), using the constructor’s default arguments.
quiz.explanation: The constructor can be called with no arguments and explicitly initializes both members. Point p(); would instead declare a function.

quiz.prompt: Point a(2,3), b; b.setX(8); What is a.getX()?
quiz.explanation: The call updates b. a still has its own x value, 2.
